phase_rows.full_contract_row: | EX-F12-P0: Definition, data and target | Implement the ten-part parent contract with its own declared inputs/definition. Binding local contract SR-F12: Capture source sequence/reset events and local transport gaps separately from market inactivity. Replay the exact captured stream, including disconnections and subscription changes, and compare the actual served versions at their completion times. Binding substantive upgrade UP-F12: Create a portable arrival-trace replay format containing source deliveries, timers, computation completions and order-state messages. Drive reference and optimized adapters from the same trace; use seeded fault schedules and minimal divergent-prefix extraction for diagnosis. Register exact added targets/ports and applicable UPGRADE_CONSTRUCTIONS before dependent code; retain every source variant and the earlier improvement path. Target: Receipt-latency distributions, raw live archive, canonical stream, parity reports and quality incidents. No live trading implied by read-only shadow capture. Confirm the exact inputs, observation clock, units, coverage and model capabilities in the linked parent contract and this local definition. Freeze definition/variant/horizon and baseline before outcomes. | Complete numeric/data/target manifest; unsupported inputs remain gated. This is a planned implementation check. |

| EX-F12-P1: Reference, causality and faults | Local mandatory cases: Disconnect/reconnect, duplicate reconnect replay, clock jump, dropped chain, delayed BBO, restart while position open, stale order state, subscription-limit denial and matching historical calculation. Full-system local cases: Sequence reset after reconnect; duplicate snapshot plus new trades; subscription changes midway through a forecast; UTC clock adjustment while monotonic elapsed time remains valid. Specific upgrade cases: Reconnect duplicates; batch boundary changes; delayed source; clock adjustment; interrupted computation; timer fires without a trade. Add suffix-deletion, delayed/corrected-input and restart equivalence through this unit and its consumers. | Named assertions with expected outcomes for every listed case; zero unexplained semantic/causal failures, bounded declared ambiguity and numerical tolerance. |

| EX-F12-P2: Isolated quality and challengers | Compare: Polling/minute snapshots versus streamed updates on common information cuts; choose by measured signal lifetime/cost. Predictive delay models are optional telemetry research, not substituted for actual receipt. Binding further upgrade and child comparisons: [UP-F12](../UPGRADE_PATHS.md#up-f12). Full-system comparison: Compare historical and live adapters on the same captured bytes before comparing separately acquired histories; estimate timing uncertainty by source/session. Specific further-upgrade comparison: Native historical replay, captured-arrival replay and adapter projections under identical event/timer traces. Primary local evidence: Reference algebra/state/coverage, numerical uncertainty and the independently scored downstream forecast role; Zero unexplained semantic divergence; measured p50/p95/p99 latency and drop rates within predeclared horizon budgets; all account and data permissions resolved before activation. Further-upgrade evidence: Decision/state parity, first divergence, lag distribution and recoverability; actual live evidence remains a later dependency. | Exact services require reference/invariance consistency; any learned comparison uses the same target/horizon/cohort, separates information from model class, fits/tunes only inside the chronology, and reports effect intervals/learning curves. |

| EX-F12-P3: Calibration, support and generalization | Exact facts get fidelity/coverage/numerical-error reports, not learned confidence. Any downstream learned head, fitted transform or uncertainty model requires chronological OOF/calibration; report year/session/age/coverage sensitivity and effective observations. | No in-sample substitution at learned edges; report unsupported/rare cohorts rather than unconditional confidence. Deterministic correctness is not an alpha claim. |

| EX-F12-P4: Increment and interactions | Ablations/controls: Degrade dependent experts and stop entries on critical feed loss; independent position protection/reconciliation survives. Class A/D; capture volume measured before retention budget. Deferred external connection and feed-cost choices are explicit deployment dependencies. Preserve source-faithful computable, corrected/earlier-upgraded and further-candidate stages. Separate added information, representation and learner capacity; apply the local geometry, latency, uncertainty and resource controls. No representative-only substitution for the other child/source variants. Also register no-component/simple-component and selected 2x2 interactions where applicable. Hard position/account/integrity constraints stay in every eligible policy comparison; relaxations are separate diagnostics. | Held-out increment under a frozen useful-effect/non-inferiority rule, or a prespecified joint interaction/invariant role; trial/search accounting complete. |

| EX-F12-P5: Decision consequences | Use: F01–11, P07 broker adapter, V06 parity. Required before short-horizon execution claims and shadow promotion. Further-upgrade use: Upgrade parity testing from isolated formula checks to reproducible whole-runtime behavior. Re-run the affected downstream chain with the reference versus changed data/state service; reconcile changed/missing candidates and latency before attributing forecast or economic gain. | Attribution reconciles with a full rerun; include rejected, untraded, no-touch and non-fill opportunities. Local score alone is insufficient for policy promotion. |

| EX-F12-P6: Integrated economic confirmation | Run the appropriate E0–E5 complete one-account/one-mini policy with independently reserved daily/account risk, actual required cutoff, all-in fees, latency/fill stress and all eligible days. Select before frozen outer/future confirmation. | Report paired daily net/risk/occupancy, account survival, uncertainty and objective gap. A useful component need not meet $2,000/day alone; the complete policy must be evaluated against that target. |

| EX-F12-P7: Future parity, monitoring and fallback | Freeze parameter policy, future endpoint/inference, input/definition/model versions and monitored local metrics (Reference algebra/state/coverage, numerical uncertainty and the independently scored downstream forecast role; Zero unexplained semantic divergence; measured p50/p95/p99 latency and drop rates within predeclared horizon budgets; all account and data permissions resolved before activation. Further-upgrade evidence: Decision/state parity, first divergence, lag distribution and recoverability; actual live evidence remains a later dependency.). Test fallback, stale state, restart and rollback. Detailed R work waits for E5; unavailable data dependencies stay disabled. | Actual captured-receipt/replay and operational evidence when authorized; no future-test tuning. Mark supported/not met/inconclusive with scope. All trading-system phases remain planned here. |

| EX-F12.PARITY-P0: Definition, data and target | Capture raw receipts and reconstruct the same canonical prefixes, processing delays and artifact versions. Binding local contract SR-F12: Capture source sequence/reset events and local transport gaps separately from market inactivity. Replay the exact captured stream, including disconnections and subscription changes, and compare the actual served versions at their completion times. Binding substantive upgrade UP-F12: Share semantic kernels across historical/captured-live paths and compare versioned traces, including receipt uncertainty. Confirm the exact inputs, observation clock, units, coverage and model capabilities in the linked parent contract and this local definition. | EX-F12.PARITY-P2: Isolated quality and challengers | Compare: Offline adapter; captured-stream replay; polling versus streaming on common cuts. public_caller_scope: __main__, verify, runtime ports, readers and named runtime/order/replay tests read fully. Import-site search across src/references/tests is discovery only; other modules are not claimed fully read.

prospective_issues.finding: No dedicated live adapter or portable arrival trace was found. Raw whole-file snapshot retention in ParquetPartitionStore is reusable but is not capture-before-decode of live frames, malformed bytes, reconnects or subscriptions.
Clocks stores UTC fields but lacks monotonic receipt, boot/clock epoch and explicit UTC adjustment. Caller supplied received provenance is not evidence of an actual measured receipt.

CriticalReactor schedules with UTC time_ns; TimerJournal rejects backward UTC, OrderLedger rejects regressed known time. Preserve actual clock discontinuity and use monotonic elapsed scheduling through an adapter; do not rewrite raw clocks.

OptionalWorkers measures monotonic duration but UTC completion/cost chronology can fail on a wall-clock step. Constructor starts a worker thread and restart abandons accepted pending work, so this is not a deterministic captured-completion replay driver.

PartitionMerge assumes unique partition/sequence under static domain config. Reconnect sequence resets and subscription generations need explicit epochs; provider sequence is not a global delivery tie-breaker.

ReplayEvent equality rejects changed receipt under the same ID. Distinguish raw delivery identity from economic identity; preserve repeated receipts while preventing double economic application in F05.

VersionStore freeze/publication kernels are reusable. Compare semantic outputs separately from transport/provenance hashes where actual receipt versus modeled scenario differs; retain both, never silently ignore timing differences.
No unified source/timer/completion/order driver, seeded named fault registry or minimal divergent-prefix diagnostic exists in the reviewed scope.
CriticalReactor crash redelivery requires idempotent external handlers; its local journal does not establish externally exactly-once broker effects.
RuntimeCosts has compute wall p95/p99, CPU and censored count; receipt lag p50/p95/p99, drops, explicit denominators and source/session clock uncertainty remain to implement and measure.
F12 ownership in verify runtime covers synthetic F04 assertions only. Runtime ports do not declare a dedicated implemented F12 trace service. Static contracts and ownership do not close F12.

normalize_mbp accepts optional strategy_received_at but native_mbp/parquet_mbp wrappers require modeled scenarios with no measured-capture passthrough. Native historical data cannot certify actual receipt.

Actual field/depth evidence gates are reusable. Adapter integration must choose certified F06/F07 eligibility semantics; legacy AvailabilityIndex priority differs and must not cause late older state resurrection.
OrderLedger is simulated only. No actual broker position reconciliation, account rights or external order-state feed is established.
Vendor docs have no complete SSE event-ID/timestamp/velocity schema or proprietary level formula. Keep snapshots/velocity/keepalive/gap distinct. A keepalive is not a market observation.
Bar timestamps are open times, not publication or receipt; countback may override from; no_data is not zero volume. Optional buy/sell totals do not recover CVD extrema or path.
API coming-soon versus limited-beta and MCP 38 versus 40 tool counts are versioned documentation differences. Account access, caps, pricing and permissions remain unverified.
All findings are static prospective issues, not executed failures. No production fixes, registration, golden edits or source-closure claims occur in this task.
